name: plumbing_ring_geometry
description: Test 11: radius 7, a single-cell network at (50,50) (an unconnected pipe on the pump's own lot), no consumers. Rings 1-3 push the diagonals (ring < 7 >> 1 = 3), later rings only the four sides, so the ring of (dx, dz) is max(|dx|,|dz|) up to 3 and 3 + max(0,|dx|-3) + max(0,|dz|-3) beyond: (53,53) ring 3, (54,54) ring 5, (50,56) ring 6 and (44,50) ring 6 are watered; (55,55) and (50,57) and (43,50) are ring 7 and are not. Counting the cells with 3 + a(dx) + a(dz) <= 6: 7 x 13 + 2 x 11 + 2 x 9 + 2 x 7 = 145 non-zero published cells (the centre is the pump lot with a pipe: 15). The redisplay box is [44, 56] x [44, 56].
